verses.ar: بِسۡمِ اللّٰہِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ الرَّحِیۡمِ ﴿۱﴾
verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
Kaf Ha Ya ‘Ain Sad.[✛]

verses.ar: ذِکۡرُ رَحۡمَتِ رَبِّکَ عَبۡدَہٗ زَکَرِیَّا ۖ﴿ۚ۳﴾
verses.en: This is an account of the mercy of thy Lord shown to His servant, Zachariah.

verses.ar: اِذۡ نَادٰی رَبَّہٗ نِدَآءً خَفِیًّا ﴿۴﴾
verses.en: When he called upon his Lord, a secret calling,

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیۡ وَہَنَ الۡعَظۡمُ مِنِّیۡ وَاشۡتَعَلَ الرَّاۡسُ شَیۡبًا وَّلَمۡ اَکُنۡۢ بِدُعَآئِکَ رَبِّ شَقِیًّا ﴿۵﴾
verses.en: He said, ‘My Lord, the bones have indeed waxed feeble in me, and the head glistens with hoariness, but never, my Lord, have I been unblessed in my prayer to Thee.

verses.ar: وَاِنِّیۡ خِفۡتُ الۡمَوَالِیَ مِنۡ وَّرَآءِیۡ وَکَانَتِ امۡرَاَتِیۡ عَاقِرًا فَہَبۡ لِیۡ مِنۡ لَّدُنۡکَ وَلِیًّا ۙ﴿۶﴾
verses.en: ‘And I fear my relations after me, and my wife is barren. Grant me, therefore, a successor from Thyself,

verses.ar: یَّرِثُنِیۡ وَیَرِثُ مِنۡ اٰلِ یَعۡقُوۡبَ ٭ۖ وَاجۡعَلۡہُ رَبِّ رَضِیًّا ﴿۷﴾
verses.en: ‘That he may be heir to me and to the House of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, well-pleasing to Thee.’
w: that he may be heir to me

verses.ar: یٰزَکَرِیَّاۤ اِنَّا نُبَشِّرُکَ بِغُلٰمِ ۣاسۡمُہٗ یَحۡیٰی ۙ لَمۡ نَجۡعَلۡ لَّہٗ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ سَمِیًّا ﴿۸﴾
verses.en: ‘O Zachariah, We give thee glad tidings of a son whose name shall be Yahya[✛]. We have not made any one before him of that name.’

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اَنّٰی یَکُوۡنُ لِیۡ غُلٰمٌ وَّکَانَتِ امۡرَاَتِیۡ عَاقِرًا وَّقَدۡ بَلَغۡتُ مِنَ الۡکِبَرِ عِتِیًّا ﴿۹﴾
verses.en: He said, ‘My Lord, how shall I have a son when my wife is barren and I have reached the extreme limit of old age?’

verses.ar: قَالَ کَذٰلِکَ ۚ قَالَ رَبُّکَ ہُوَ عَلَیَّ ہَیِّنٌ وَّقَدۡ خَلَقۡتُکَ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ وَلَمۡ تَکُ شَیۡئًا ﴿۱۰﴾
verses.en: He said, ‘So it is.’ But thy Lord says, ‘It is easy for Me, and indeed I created thee before, when thou wast nothing.’

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اجۡعَلۡ لِّیۡۤ اٰیَۃً ؕ قَالَ اٰیَتُکَ اَلَّا تُکَلِّمَ النَّاسَ ثَلٰثَ لَیَالٍ سَوِیًّا ﴿۱۱﴾
verses.en: He said, ‘My Lord, appoint for me a token.’God said, ‘Thy token is that thou shalt not speak to anyone for three full days and nights.’
w: is that thou shalt not speak

verses.ar: فَخَرَجَ عَلٰی قَوۡمِہٖ مِنَ الۡمِحۡرَابِ فَاَوۡحٰۤی اِلَیۡہِمۡ اَنۡ سَبِّحُوۡا بُکۡرَۃً وَّعَشِیًّا ﴿۱۲﴾
verses.en: Then he came forth unto his people from the chamber and asked them by signs to glorify God in the morning and in the evening.

verses.ar: یٰیَحۡیٰی خُذِ الۡکِتٰبَ بِقُوَّۃٍ ؕ وَاٰتَیۡنٰہُ الۡحُکۡمَ صَبِیًّا ﴿ۙ۱۳﴾
verses.en: ‘O Yahya, hold fast the Book.’ And We gave him wisdom while yet a child,

verses.ar: وَّحَنَانًا مِّنۡ لَّدُنَّا وَزَکٰوۃً ؕ وَکَانَ تَقِیًّا ﴿ۙ۱۴﴾
verses.en: And tenderness of heart from Ourself, and purity. And he was pious

verses.ar: وَّبَرًّۢا بِوَالِدَیۡہِ وَلَمۡ یَکُنۡ جَبَّارًا عَصِیًّا ﴿۱۵﴾
verses.en: And dutiful toward his parents. And he was not haughty and rebellious.

verses.ar: وَسَلٰمٌ عَلَیۡہِ یَوۡمَ وُلِدَ وَیَوۡمَ یَمُوۡتُ وَیَوۡمَ یُبۡعَثُ حَیًّا ﴿٪۱۶﴾
verses.en: And peace was on him the day he was born, and the day he died, and peace there will be on him the day he will be raised up to life again.
w: and peace there will be on him the day

verses.ar: وَاذۡکُرۡ فِی الۡکِتٰبِ مَرۡیَمَ ۘ اِذِ انۡتَبَذَتۡ مِنۡ اَہۡلِہَا مَکَانًا شَرۡقِیًّا ﴿ۙ۱۷﴾
verses.en: And relate the story of Mary as mentioned in the Book. When she withdrew from her people to a place to the east,

verses.ar: فَاتَّخَذَتۡ مِنۡ دُوۡنِہِمۡ حِجَابًا ۪۟ فَاَرۡسَلۡنَاۤ اِلَیۡہَا رُوۡحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَہَا بَشَرًا سَوِیًّا ﴿۱۸﴾
verses.en: And screened herself off from them, then We sent Our angel to her, and he appeared to her in the form of a perfect man.
w: in the form of a perfect

verses.ar: قَالَتۡ اِنِّیۡۤ اَعُوۡذُ بِالرَّحۡمٰنِ مِنۡکَ اِنۡ کُنۡتَ تَقِیًّا ﴿۱۹﴾
verses.en: She said, ‘I seek refuge with the Gracious God from thee if indeed thou dost fear Him.’

verses.ar: قَالَ اِنَّمَاۤ اَنَا رَسُوۡلُ رَبِّکِ ٭ۖ لِاَہَبَ لَکِ غُلٰمًا زَکِیًّا ﴿۲۰﴾
verses.en: He replied, ‘I am only a Messenger of thy Lord, that I may bestow on thee a righteous son.’

verses.ar: قَالَتۡ اَنّٰی یَکُوۡنُ لِیۡ غُلٰمٌ وَّلَمۡ یَمۡسَسۡنِیۡ بَشَرٌ وَّلَمۡ اَکُ بَغِیًّا ﴿۲۱﴾
verses.en: She said, ‘How can I have a son when no man has touched me, neither have I been unchaste?’

verses.ar: قَالَ کَذٰلِکِ ۚ قَالَ رَبُّکِ ہُوَ عَلَیَّ ہَیِّنٌ ۚ وَلِنَجۡعَلَہٗۤ اٰیَۃً لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحۡمَۃً مِّنَّا ۚ وَکَانَ اَمۡرًا مَّقۡضِیًّا ﴿۲۲﴾
verses.en: He replied, ‘Thus it is.’ But says thy Lord, ‘It is easy for Me; and We shall do so that We may make him a Sign unto men, and a mercy from Us, and it is a thing decreed.’
w: and We shall do so that We may make him

verses.ar: فَحَمَلَتۡہُ فَانۡتَبَذَتۡ بِہٖ مَکَانًا قَصِیًّا ﴿۲۳﴾
verses.en: So she conceived him, and withdrew with him to a remote place.

verses.ar: فَاَجَآءَہَا الۡمَخَاضُ اِلٰی جِذۡعِ النَّخۡلَۃِ ۚ قَالَتۡ یٰلَیۡتَنِیۡ مِتُّ قَبۡلَ ہٰذَا وَکُنۡتُ نَسۡیًا مَّنۡسِیًّا ﴿۲۴﴾
verses.en: [✲]And the pains of childbirth drove her unto the trunk of a palm-tree. She said, ‘O! would that I had died before this and had become a thing quite forgotten!’

verses.ar: فَنَادٰٮہَا مِنۡ تَحۡتِہَاۤ اَلَّا تَحۡزَنِیۡ قَدۡ جَعَلَ رَبُّکِ تَحۡتَکِ سَرِیًّا ﴿۲۵﴾
verses.en: Then he called her from beneath her, saying, “Grieve not. Thy Lord has placed a rivulet below thee;

verses.ar: وَہُزِّیۡۤ اِلَیۡکِ بِجِذۡعِ النَّخۡلَۃِ تُسٰقِطۡ عَلَیۡکِ رُطَبًا جَنِیًّا ﴿۫۲۶﴾
verses.en: [✲]“And shake towards thyself the trunk of the palm-tree; it will cause fresh ripe dates to fall upon thee.

verses.ar: فَکُلِیۡ وَاشۡرَبِیۡ وَقَرِّیۡ عَیۡنًا ۚ فَاِمَّا تَرَیِنَّ مِنَ الۡبَشَرِ اَحَدًا ۙ فَقُوۡلِیۡۤ اِنِّیۡ نَذَرۡتُ لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ صَوۡمًا فَلَنۡ اُکَلِّمَ الۡیَوۡمَ اِنۡسِیًّا ﴿ۚ۲۷﴾
verses.en: “So eat and drink, and cool thy eye. And if thou seest any man, say, ‘I have vowed a fast to the Gracious God; I will therefore not speak this day to any human being.’”

verses.ar: فَاَتَتۡ بِہٖ قَوۡمَہَا تَحۡمِلُہٗ ؕ قَالُوۡا یٰمَرۡیَمُ لَقَدۡ جِئۡتِ شَیۡئًا فَرِیًّا ﴿۲۸﴾
verses.en: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, ‘O Mary, thou hast brought forth a strange thing.

verses.ar: یٰۤاُخۡتَ ہٰرُوۡنَ مَا کَانَ اَبُوۡکِ امۡرَاَ سَوۡءٍ وَّمَا کَانَتۡ اُمُّکِ بَغِیًّا ﴿ۖۚ۲۹﴾
verses.en: ‘O sister of Aaron, thy father was not a wicked man nor was thy mother an unchaste woman!’

verses.ar: فَاَشَارَتۡ اِلَیۡہِ ؕ قَالُوۡا کَیۡفَ نُکَلِّمُ مَنۡ کَانَ فِی الۡمَہۡدِ صَبِیًّا ﴿۳۰﴾
verses.en: Then she pointed to him. They said, ‘How can we talk to one who is a child in the cradle?’

verses.ar: قَالَ اِنِّیۡ عَبۡدُ اللّٰہِ ۟ؕ اٰتٰنِیَ الۡکِتٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِیۡ نَبِیًّا ﴿ۙ۳۱﴾
verses.en: He said, ‘I am a servant of Allah. He has given me the Book, and made me a Prophet;

verses.ar: وَّجَعَلَنِیۡ مُبٰرَکًا اَیۡنَ مَا کُنۡتُ ۪ وَاَوۡصٰنِیۡ بِالصَّلٰوۃِ وَالزَّکٰوۃِ مَا دُمۡتُ حَیًّا ﴿۪ۖ۳۲﴾
verses.en: ‘And He has made me blessed wheresoever I may be, and has enjoined upon me Prayer and almsgiving so long as I live;

verses.ar: وَّبَرًّۢا بِوَالِدَتِیۡ ۫ وَلَمۡ یَجۡعَلۡنِیۡ جَبَّارًا شَقِیًّا ﴿۳۳﴾
verses.en: ‘And He has made me dutiful toward my mother, and He has not made me haughty and unblessed.

verses.ar: وَالسَّلٰمُ عَلَیَّ یَوۡمَ وُلِدۡتُّ وَیَوۡمَ اَمُوۡتُ وَیَوۡمَ اُبۡعَثُ حَیًّا ﴿۳۴﴾
verses.en: ‘And peace was on me the day I was born, and peace there will be on me the day I shall die, and the day I shall be raised up to life again.’
w: and peace there will be on me the day

verses.ar: ذٰلِکَ عِیۡسَی ابۡنُ مَرۡیَمَ ۚ قَوۡلَ الۡحَقِّ الَّذِیۡ فِیۡہِ یَمۡتَرُوۡنَ ﴿۳۵﴾
verses.en: Such was Jesus, son of Mary. This is a statement of the truth about which they doubt.

verses.ar: مَا کَانَ لِلّٰہِ اَنۡ یَّتَّخِذَ مِنۡ وَّلَدٍ ۙ سُبۡحٰنَہٗ ؕ اِذَا قَضٰۤی اَمۡرًا فَاِنَّمَا یَقُوۡلُ لَہٗ کُنۡ فَیَکُوۡنُ ﴿ؕ۳۶﴾
verses.en: [✲]It does not befit the Majesty of Allah to take unto Himself a son. Holy is He. When He decrees a thing, He says to it, ‘Be!’, and it is.

verses.ar: وَاِنَّ اللّٰہَ رَبِّیۡ وَرَبُّکُمۡ فَاعۡبُدُوۡہُ ؕ ہٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسۡتَقِیۡمٌ ﴿۳۷﴾
verses.en: Said Jesus: ‘Surely, Allah is my Lord, and your Lord. So worship Him alone; this is the right path.’

verses.ar: فَاخۡتَلَفَ الۡاَحۡزَابُ مِنۡۢ بَیۡنِہِمۡ ۚ فَوَیۡلٌ لِّلَّذِیۡنَ کَفَرُوۡا مِنۡ مَّشۡہَدِ یَوۡمٍ عَظِیۡمٍ ﴿۳۸﴾
verses.en: But the parties differed among themselves; so woe to those who disbelieve because of the meeting of the great day.

verses.ar: اَسۡمِعۡ بِہِمۡ وَاَبۡصِرۡ ۙ یَوۡمَ یَاۡتُوۡنَنَا لٰکِنِ الظّٰلِمُوۡنَ الۡیَوۡمَ فِیۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِیۡنٍ ﴿۳۹﴾
verses.en: How wonderful will their hearing and seeing be on the day when they will come to Us! But today the wrongdoers are in manifest error.

verses.ar: وَاَنۡذِرۡہُمۡ یَوۡمَ الۡحَسۡرَۃِ اِذۡ قُضِیَ الۡاَمۡرُ ۘ وَہُمۡ فِیۡ غَفۡلَۃٍ وَّہُمۡ لَا یُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ ﴿۴۰﴾
verses.en: And warn them of the day of grief when the matter will be decided. But now they are in a state of carelessness, so they do not believe.

verses.ar: اِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَرِثُ الۡاَرۡضَ وَمَنۡ عَلَیۡہَا وَاِلَیۡنَا یُرۡجَعُوۡنَ ﴿٪۴۱﴾
verses.en: It is We Who will inherit the earth and all who are thereon; and to Us will they all be returned.

verses.ar: وَاذۡکُرۡ فِی الۡکِتٰبِ اِبۡرٰہِیۡمَ ۬ؕ اِنَّہٗ کَانَ صِدِّیۡقًا نَّبِیًّا ﴿۴۲﴾
verses.en: And relate the story of Abraham as mentioned in the Book. He was a truthful man and a Prophet.

verses.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لِاَبِیۡہِ یٰۤاَبَتِ لِمَ تَعۡبُدُ مَا لَا یَسۡمَعُ وَلَا یُبۡصِرُ وَلَا یُغۡنِیۡ عَنۡکَ شَیۡئًا ﴿۴۳﴾
verses.en: When he said to his father, ‘O my father, why dost thou worship that which hears not, nor sees, nor can avail thee aught?

verses.ar: یٰۤاَبَتِ اِنِّیۡ قَدۡ جَآءَنِیۡ مِنَ الۡعِلۡمِ مَا لَمۡ یَاۡتِکَ فَاتَّبِعۡنِیۡۤ اَہۡدِکَ صِرَاطًا سَوِیًّا ﴿۴۴﴾
verses.en: ‘O my father, there has indeed come to me knowledge such as has not come to thee; so follow me, I will guide thee to an even path.

verses.ar: یٰۤاَبَتِ لَا تَعۡبُدِ الشَّیۡطٰنَ ؕ اِنَّ الشَّیۡطٰنَ کَانَ لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ عَصِیًّا ﴿۴۵﴾
verses.en: ‘O my father, serve not Satan; surely, Satan is a rebel against the Gracious God.

verses.ar: یٰۤاَبَتِ اِنِّیۡۤ اَخَافُ اَنۡ یَّمَسَّکَ عَذَابٌ مِّنَ الرَّحۡمٰنِ فَتَکُوۡنَ لِلشَّیۡطٰنِ وَلِیًّا ﴿۴۶﴾
verses.en: ‘O my father, indeed, I fear lest a punishment from the Gracious God seize thee, and thou become a comrade of Satan.’

verses.ar: قَالَ اَرَاغِبٌ اَنۡتَ عَنۡ اٰلِہَتِیۡ یٰۤـاِبۡرٰہِیۡمُ ۚ لَئِنۡ لَّمۡ تَنۡتَہِ لَاَرۡجُمَنَّکَ وَاہۡجُرۡنِیۡ مَلِیًّا ﴿۴۷﴾
verses.en: He replied, ‘Dost thou turn away from my gods, O Abraham? If thou cease not, I shall surely cut off all relations with thee. Now leave me alone for a long while.’
w: I shall surely cut off all relations with thee

verses.ar: قَالَ سَلٰمٌ عَلَیۡکَ ۚ سَاَسۡتَغۡفِرُ لَکَ رَبِّیۡ ؕ اِنَّہٗ کَانَ بِیۡ حَفِیًّا ﴿۴۸﴾
verses.en: Abraham said, ‘Peace be on thee.’ I will ask forgiveness of my Lord for thee. He is indeed gracious to me.

verses.ar: وَاَعۡتَزِلُکُمۡ وَمَا تَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰہِ وَاَدۡعُوۡا رَبِّیۡ ۫ۖ عَسٰۤی اَلَّاۤ اَکُوۡنَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّیۡ شَقِیًّا ﴿۴۹﴾
verses.en: ‘And I shall keep away from you and from that which you call upon beside Allah; and I will pray unto my Lord; it may be that, in praying to my Lord, I shall not be disappointed.’
w: and I shall keep away from you

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا اعۡتَزَلَہُمۡ وَمَا یَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰہِ ۙ وَہَبۡنَا لَہٗۤ اِسۡحٰقَ وَیَعۡقُوۡبَ ؕ وَکُلًّا جَعَلۡنَا نَبِیًّا ﴿۵۰﴾
verses.en: So when he had separated himself from them and from that which they worshipped beside Allah, We bestowed on him Isaac and Jacob, and each of them We made a Prophet.
w: he had separated himself from them

verses.ar: وَوَہَبۡنَا لَہُمۡ مِّنۡ رَّحۡمَتِنَا وَجَعَلۡنَا لَہُمۡ لِسَانَ صِدۡقٍ عَلِیًّا ﴿٪۵۱﴾
verses.en: And We granted them of Our mercy; and We bestowed on them a true renown.

verses.ar: وَاذۡکُرۡ فِی الۡکِتٰبِ مُوۡسٰۤی ۫ اِنَّہٗ کَانَ مُخۡلَصًا وَّکَانَ رَسُوۡلًا نَّبِیًّا ﴿۵۲﴾
verses.en: And relate the story of Moses as mentioned in the Book. He was indeed a chosen one; and he was a Messenger, a Prophet.

verses.ar: وَنَادَیۡنٰہُ مِنۡ جَانِبِ الطُّوۡرِ الۡاَیۡمَنِ وَقَرَّبۡنٰہُ نَجِیًّا ﴿۵۳﴾
verses.en: And We called him from the right side of the Mount, and made him draw near to Us for special communion.
w: and made him draw near to Us

verses.ar: وَوَہَبۡنَا لَہٗ مِنۡ رَّحۡمَتِنَاۤ اَخَاہُ ہٰرُوۡنَ نَبِیًّا ﴿۵۴﴾
verses.en: And We bestowed upon him, out of Our mercy, his brother Aaron as a Prophet.

verses.ar: وَاذۡکُرۡ فِی الۡکِتٰبِ اِسۡمٰعِیۡلَ ۫ اِنَّہٗ کَانَ صَادِقَ الۡوَعۡدِ وَکَانَ رَسُوۡلًا نَّبِیًّا ﴿ۚ۵۵﴾
verses.en: And relate the story of Ishmael as mentioned in the Book. He was indeed strict in keeping his promise. And he was a Messenger, a Prophet.

verses.ar: وَکَانَ یَاۡمُرُ اَہۡلَہٗ بِالصَّلٰوۃِ وَالزَّکٰوۃِ ۪ وَکَانَ عِنۡدَ رَبِّہٖ مَرۡضِیًّا ﴿۵۶﴾
verses.en: He used to enjoin Prayer and almsgiving on his people, and he was well pleasing to his Lord.

verses.ar: وَاذۡکُرۡ فِی الۡکِتٰبِ اِدۡرِیۡسَ ۫ اِنَّہٗ کَانَ صِدِّیۡقًا نَّبِیًّا ﴿٭ۙ۵۷﴾
verses.en: And relate the story of Idris as mentioned in the Book. He was a truthful man and a Prophet.

verses.ar: وَّرَفَعۡنٰہُ مَکَانًا عَلِیًّا ﴿۵۸﴾
verses.en: And We exalted him to a lofty station.

verses.ar: اُولٰٓئِکَ الَّذِیۡنَ اَنۡعَمَ اللّٰہُ عَلَیۡہِمۡ مِّنَ النَّبِیّٖنَ مِنۡ ذُرِّیَّۃِ اٰدَمَ ٭ وَمِمَّنۡ حَمَلۡنَا مَعَ نُوۡحٍ ۫ وَّمِنۡ ذُرِّیَّۃِ اِبۡرٰہِیۡمَ وَاِسۡرَآءِیۡلَ ۫ وَمِمَّنۡ ہَدَیۡنَا وَاجۡتَبَیۡنَا ؕ اِذَا تُتۡلٰی عَلَیۡہِمۡ اٰیٰتُ الرَّحۡمٰنِ خَرُّوۡا سُجَّدًا وَّبُکِیًّا ﴿ٛ۵۹﴾
verses.en: These are the people on whom Allah bestowed His blessings from among the Prophets, of the posterity of Adam, and of the posterity of those whom We carried in the Ark with Noah, and of the posterity of Abraham and Israel; and they are of those whom We guided and chose. When the Signs of the Gracious God were recited unto them, they fell down, prostrating themselves before God and weeping.
w: and of the posterity of those whom

verses.ar: فَخَلَفَ مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِہِمۡ خَلۡفٌ اَضَاعُوا الصَّلٰوۃَ وَاتَّبَعُوا الشَّہَوٰتِ فَسَوۡفَ یَلۡقَوۡنَ غَیًّا ﴿ۙ۶۰﴾
verses.en: Then there came after them descendants who neglected Prayer, and followed evil desires. So they will meet with destruction,

verses.ar: اِلَّا مَنۡ تَابَ وَاٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَاُولٰٓئِکَ یَدۡخُلُوۡنَ الۡجَنَّۃَ وَلَا یُظۡلَمُوۡنَ شَیۡئًا ﴿ۙ۶۱﴾
verses.en: Except those who repent and believe and do good deeds. These will enter Heaven, and they will not be wronged in the least —

verses.ar: جَنّٰتِ عَدۡنِ ۣالَّتِیۡ وَعَدَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ عِبَادَہٗ بِالۡغَیۡبِ ؕ اِنَّہٗ کَانَ وَعۡدُہٗ مَاۡتِیًّا ﴿۶۲﴾
verses.en: Gardens of Eternity, which the Gracious God has promised to His servants in the unseen. Surely, His promise must come to pass.

verses.ar: لَا یَسۡمَعُوۡنَ فِیۡہَا لَغۡوًا اِلَّا سَلٰمًا ؕ وَلَہُمۡ رِزۡقُہُمۡ فِیۡہَا بُکۡرَۃً وَّعَشِیًّا ﴿۶۳﴾
verses.en: They will not hear therein anything vain, but only greetings of Peace: and they will have their sustenance therein, morning and evening.

verses.ar: تِلۡکَ الۡجَنَّۃُ الَّتِیۡ نُوۡرِثُ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا مَنۡ کَانَ تَقِیًّا ﴿۶۴﴾
verses.en: Such is the Heaven which We give for an inheritance to those of Our servants who are righteous.

verses.ar: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ اِلَّا بِاَمۡرِ رَبِّکَ ۚ لَہٗ مَا بَیۡنَ اَیۡدِیۡنَا وَمَا خَلۡفَنَا وَمَا بَیۡنَ ذٰلِکَ ۚ وَمَا کَانَ رَبُّکَ نَسِیًّا ﴿ۚ۶۵﴾
verses.en: ‘And we (angels) do not come down save by the command of thy Lord. To Him belongs all that is  before us and all that is behind us and all that is between; and thy Lord is not forgetful.’

verses.ar: رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَیۡنَہُمَا فَاعۡبُدۡہُ وَاصۡطَبِرۡ لِعِبَادَتِہٖ ؕ ہَلۡ تَعۡلَمُ لَہٗ سَمِیًّا ﴿٪۶۶﴾
verses.en: He is the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of all that is between the two. Serve Him, therefore, and be steadfast in His service. Dost thou know any equal of His?

verses.ar: وَیَقُوۡلُ الۡاِنۡسَانُ ءَاِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوۡفَ اُخۡرَجُ حَیًّا ﴿۶۷﴾
verses.en: And says man, ‘What! when I am dead, shall I be brought forth alive?’

verses.ar: اَوَلَا یَذۡکُرُ الۡاِنۡسَانُ اَنَّا خَلَقۡنٰہُ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ وَلَمۡ یَکُ شَیۡئًا ﴿۶۸﴾
verses.en: Does not man remember that We created him before, when he was naught?

verses.ar: فَوَرَبِّکَ لَنَحۡشُرَنَّہُمۡ وَالشَّیٰطِیۡنَ ثُمَّ لَنُحۡضِرَنَّہُمۡ حَوۡلَ جَہَنَّمَ جِثِیًّا ﴿ۚ۶۹﴾
verses.en: And, by thy Lord, We shall assuredly gather them together, and the satans too; then shall We bring them on their knees around Hell.
w: We shall assuredly gather them together

verses.ar: ثُمَّ لَنَنۡزِعَنَّ مِنۡ کُلِّ شِیۡعَۃٍ اَیُّہُمۡ اَشَدُّ عَلَی الرَّحۡمٰنِ عِتِیًّا ﴿ۚ۷۰﴾
verses.en: [✲]Then shall We certainly pick out, from every group, those of them who were most stubborn in rebellion against the Gracious God.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ لَنَحۡنُ اَعۡلَمُ بِالَّذِیۡنَ ہُمۡ اَوۡلٰی بِہَا صِلِیًّا ﴿۷۱﴾
verses.en: And surely, We know best those most deserving to be burned therein.

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ مِّنۡکُمۡ اِلَّا وَارِدُہَا ۚ کَانَ عَلٰی رَبِّکَ حَتۡمًا مَّقۡضِیًّا ﴿ۚ۷۲﴾
verses.en: And there is not one of you but will come to it. This is a fixed decree with thy Lord.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّی الَّذِیۡنَ اتَّقَوۡا وَّنَذَرُ الظّٰلِمِیۡنَ فِیۡہَا جِثِیًّا ﴿۷۳﴾
verses.en: Then We shall save the righteous and We shall leave the wrongdoers therein, on their knees.

verses.ar: وَاِذَا تُتۡلٰی عَلَیۡہِمۡ اٰیٰتُنَا بَیِّنٰتٍ قَالَ الَّذِیۡنَ کَفَرُوۡا لِلَّذِیۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡۤا ۙ اَیُّ الۡفَرِیۡقَیۡنِ خَیۡرٌ مَّقَامًا وَّاَحۡسَنُ نَدِیًّا ﴿۷۴﴾
verses.en: And when Our manifest Signs are recited unto them, the disbelievers say to the believers, ‘Which of the two parties is better in respect of position and makes a more impressive assembly?’

verses.ar: وَکَمۡ اَہۡلَکۡنَا قَبۡلَہُمۡ مِّنۡ قَرۡنٍ ہُمۡ اَحۡسَنُ اَثَاثًا وَّرِءۡیًا ﴿۷۵﴾
verses.en: And how many generations have We destroyed before them, who were better off in wealth and better in outward show!

verses.ar: قُلۡ مَنۡ کَانَ فِی الضَّلٰلَۃِ فَلۡیَمۡدُدۡ لَہُ الرَّحۡمٰنُ مَدًّا ۬ۚ حَتّٰۤی اِذَا رَاَوۡا مَا یُوۡعَدُوۡنَ اِمَّا الۡعَذَابَ وَاِمَّا السَّاعَۃَ ؕ فَسَیَعۡلَمُوۡنَ مَنۡ ہُوَ شَرٌّ مَّکَانًا وَّاَضۡعَفُ جُنۡدًا ﴿۷۶﴾
verses.en: Say, ‘The Gracious God does give those who are in error long respite until, when they will see that with which they are threatened — whether it be punishment or the Hour — they will realize who is worse in respect of position and who is weaker in forces.

verses.ar: وَیَزِیۡدُ اللّٰہُ الَّذِیۡنَ اہۡتَدَوۡا ہُدًی ؕ وَالۡبٰقِیٰتُ الصّٰلِحٰتُ خَیۡرٌ عِنۡدَ رَبِّکَ ثَوَابًا وَّخَیۡرٌ مَّرَدًّا ﴿۷۷﴾
verses.en: ‘And Allah increases in guidance those who follow guidance. And the good works that endure are best in sight of thy Lord as reward, and best as resort.’

verses.ar: اَفَرَءَیۡتَ الَّذِیۡ کَفَرَ بِاٰیٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَاُوۡتَیَنَّ مَالًا وَّوَلَدًا ﴿ؕ۷۸﴾
verses.en: Hast thou then seen him who disbelieves in Our Signs, and says, ‘I shall certainly be given wealth and children?’

verses.ar: اَطَّلَعَ الۡغَیۡبَ اَمِ اتَّخَذَ عِنۡدَ الرَّحۡمٰنِ عَہۡدًا ﴿ۙ۷۹﴾
verses.en: Has he become acquainted with the unseen or has he taken a promise from the Gracious God?

verses.ar: کَلَّا ؕ سَنَکۡتُبُ مَا یَقُوۡلُ وَنَمُدُّ لَہٗ مِنَ الۡعَذَابِ مَدًّا ﴿ۙ۸۰﴾
verses.en: Nay! We shall note down what he says and We shall greatly prolong for him the punishment.

verses.ar: وَّنَرِثُہٗ مَا یَقُوۡلُ وَیَاۡتِیۡنَا فَرۡدًا ﴿۸۱﴾
verses.en: And We shall inherit of him all that of which he talks, and he shall come to Us all alone.
w: and We shall inherit of him
and he shall come to Us

verses.ar: وَاتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰہِ اٰلِہَۃً لِّیَکُوۡنُوۡا لَہُمۡ عِزًّا ﴿ۙ۸۲﴾
verses.en: And they have taken other gods beside Allah, that they may be a source of power for them.

verses.ar: کَلَّا ؕ سَیَکۡفُرُوۡنَ بِعِبَادَتِہِمۡ وَیَکُوۡنُوۡنَ عَلَیۡہِمۡ ضِدًّا ﴿٪۸۳﴾
verses.en: Not at all! They will reject their worship, and become their opponents.

verses.ar: اَلَمۡ تَرَ اَنَّـاۤ اَرۡسَلۡنَا الشَّیٰطِیۡنَ عَلَی الۡکٰفِرِیۡنَ تَؤُزُّہُمۡ اَزًّا ﴿ۙ۸۴﴾
verses.en: Seest thou not that We have sent satans against the disbelievers goading them on to acts of disobedience?
w: goading them on to acts of disobedience

verses.ar: فَلَا تَعۡجَلۡ عَلَیۡہِمۡ ؕ اِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَہُمۡ عَدًّا ﴿ۚ۸۵﴾
verses.en: So be not thou in haste with regard to them; We are keeping full account of their doings.

verses.ar: یَوۡمَ نَحۡشُرُ الۡمُتَّقِیۡنَ اِلَی الرَّحۡمٰنِ وَفۡدًا ﴿ۙ۸۶﴾
verses.en: Remember the day when We shall gather the righteous before the Gracious God as honoured guests.

verses.ar: وَّنَسُوۡقُ الۡمُجۡرِمِیۡنَ اِلٰی جَہَنَّمَ وِرۡدًا ﴿ۘ۸۷﴾
verses.en: [✲]And We shall drive the guilty to Hell like a herd of thirsty camels.

verses.ar: لَا یَمۡلِکُوۡنَ الشَّفَاعَۃَ اِلَّا مَنِ اتَّخَذَ عِنۡدَ الرَّحۡمٰنِ عَہۡدًا ﴿ۘ۸۸﴾
verses.en: None will have the power of intercession save he who has received a promise from the Gracious God.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ وَلَدًا ﴿ؕ۸۹﴾
verses.en: And they say, ‘The Gracious God has taken unto Himself a son.’

verses.ar: لَقَدۡ جِئۡتُمۡ شَیۡئًا اِدًّا ﴿ۙ۹۰﴾
verses.en: Assuredly, you have done a most monstrous thing!

verses.ar: تَکَادُ السَّمٰوٰتُ یَتَفَطَّرۡنَ مِنۡہُ وَتَنۡشَقُّ الۡاَرۡضُ وَتَخِرُّ الۡجِبَالُ ہَدًّا ﴿ۙ۹۱﴾
verses.en: The heavens might well-nigh burst thereat, and the earth cleave asunder, and the mountains fall down in pieces,

verses.ar: اَنۡ دَعَوۡا لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ وَلَدًا ﴿ۚ۹۲﴾
verses.en: Because they ascribe a son to the Gracious God.

verses.ar: وَمَا یَنۡۢبَغِیۡ لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ اَنۡ یَّتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا ﴿ؕ۹۳﴾
verses.en: Whereas it becomes not the Gracious God to take unto Himself a son.

verses.ar: اِنۡ کُلُّ مَنۡ فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ اِلَّاۤ اٰتِی الرَّحۡمٰنِ عَبۡدًا ﴿ؕ۹۴﴾
verses.en: There is none in the heavens and the earth but he shall come to the Gracious God as a bondman.

verses.ar: لَقَدۡ اَحۡصٰہُمۡ وَعَدَّہُمۡ عَدًّا ﴿ؕ۹۵﴾
verses.en: Verily, He comprehends them by His knowledge and has numbered them all fully.

verses.ar: وَکُلُّہُمۡ اٰتِیۡہِ یَوۡمَ الۡقِیٰمَۃِ فَرۡدًا ﴿۹۶﴾
verses.en: And each of them shall come to Him singly on the Day of Resurrection.

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِیۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ سَیَجۡعَلُ لَہُمُ الرَّحۡمٰنُ وُدًّا ﴿۹۷﴾
verses.en: Those who believe and do good deeds — the Gracious God will create love in their hearts.

verses.ar: فَاِنَّمَا یَسَّرۡنٰہُ بِلِسَانِکَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِہِ الۡمُتَّقِیۡنَ وَتُنۡذِرَ بِہٖ قَوۡمًا لُّدًّا ﴿۹۸﴾
verses.en: So We have made it (the Qur’an) easy in thy tongue that thou mayest give thereby good tidings to the righteous, and warn thereby a people given to contention.
w: We have made it (the Qur’an) easy
that thou mayest give good tidings

verses.ar: وَکَمۡ اَہۡلَکۡنَا قَبۡلَہُمۡ مِّنۡ قَرۡنٍ ؕ ہَلۡ تُحِسُّ مِنۡہُمۡ مِّنۡ اَحَدٍ اَوۡ تَسۡمَعُ لَہُمۡ رِکۡزًا ﴿٪۹۹﴾
verses.en: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them! Canst thou see a single one of them, or hear even a whisper of them?
